common.shownOnce: Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe. For your security it is shown only this once.

validate.email: This does not look like an email address.
validate.url: Enter a full web address starting with https://
validate.passwordRule: At least 10 characters. A few random words work well.
validate.passwordMismatch: The passwords are not the same.

errors.invalid_request: The request was not accepted. Check your input.
errors.insufficient_scope: This key is not allowed to do that.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.not_found: This could not be found. It may have been removed.
errors.conflict: This conflicts with something that already exists.

errors.unsupported_media_type: This file type is not supported.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
errors.limit_exceeded: That is more than allowed at once.
errors.cursor_invalid: The list is out of date. Reload the page.
errors.cursor_expired: The list is out of date. Reload the page.
errors.export_expired: This download has expired. Please prepare it again.
errors.original_not_allowed: Original files are not available to you. Choose Web or Square.
errors.gtin_conflict: This EAN is already used for another size.
errors.position_conflict: Another image already has this position.

login.title: Log in to {{portal}}
login.intro: Log in to see and download product images and article data.

password.forgotIntro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
password.forgotSent: If this address has an account, you will receive an email with a link within a few minutes.
password.resetIntro: Choose a password you don't use anywhere else.

invite.title: Welcome
invite.introRetailer: {{brand}} has given {{retailer}} access to its product images and article data, and invited you. Choose a password to get started.
invite.introAdmin: You've been invited to manage this portal. Choose a password to get started.
invite.invalid: The link has already been used or has expired. Ask the person who invited you to send a new invitation.

request.title: Request access to {{brand}}
request.intro: Tell us who you are. We will check your request and let you know by email.
request.portalHint: Browse, select and download images and article data yourself.
request.apiHint: Let your shop system or PIM fetch products and images automatically.
request.customerNumberHint: If you already buy from us.
request.sent: Thank you. {{brand}} will review your request and email you at {{email}}.
request.closed: This brand does not accept new requests online. Please contact them directly.

setup.title: Set up your brand portal
setup.intro: Four short steps. You can change everything later.
setup.codeHint: Shown when the portal was installed (on screen or in its log), or chosen by whoever installed it.
setup.codeShort: The setup code has at least 6 characters.
setup.codeWrong: This setup code is not correct.
setup.companyNameHint: Shown at the top of every page and in emails: use the name retailers know you by.
setup.firstBrandHint: The first brand in your catalog; you can add more later. Leave empty to use the company name.
setup.contactEmailHint: Shown to retailers who have a question.
setup.defaultLanguage: Main language of your product texts
setup.defaultLanguageHint: Used for texts in your files that don't say which language they are in.
setup.contentLanguagesHint: The languages you write names and descriptions in.
setup.accentHint: Used for buttons and highlights in your portal.

dashboard.intro: What is happening with your product content.
dashboard.getStartedHint: A few steps and your retailers can get going.

step.look: Add your logo and welcome text
step.automate: Publish automatically from your own systems

dashboard.activitySummary: Last 30 days: {{downloads}} downloads, {{images}} images, {{retailers}} active retailers.
dashboard.noActivityHint: As soon as retailers download images or data, you'll see it here.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.intro: Your articles, their sizes and images. Only published articles are visible to retailers.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Article number, name, EAN or SKU
catalog.empty: Import a CSV file with your articles and a folder of images, or add an article by hand.

product.newIntro: Start with the basics. Sizes and images come next.
product.styleHint: Your own article (style) number. It identifies the article and cannot be changed later.
product.styleLocked: The article number identifies this article and cannot be changed.
product.seasonHint: As you use it, for example AW26 or NOS.
product.materialsHint: Like on the label: “outer: 65% cotton, 35% polyamide; lining: 100% polyester”.
product.materialsInvalid: We could not read “{{part}}”. Use a percentage and a material, like 100% cotton.
product.materialsNot100: The percentages of {{parts}} do not add up to 100%.
product.careHint: Pick the symbols from the care label, in label order.
product.dppHint: Link to the digital product passport, if there is one.
product.publishedOn: Retailers can see and download this article.
product.publishedOff: Hidden from retailers. Your changes stay here.
product.pendingFilesHint: Some images are still being processed. They appear for retailers as soon as they are ready.
product.sizesHint: One line per colour and size, with its EAN.
product.noSizesHint: Add each colour and size with its EAN, so retailers can find the article by barcode.
product.gtinInvalid: This EAN is not valid. Check the digits.
product.colourCodeHint: Your code for this colour, for example NVY. Images are grouped by it.
product.deleteSizeBody: Retailers will no longer find it by EAN.
product.imagesHint: Upload the final images. Web and square versions are made automatically; your original file is kept exactly as it is.
product.imagesHintClient: Upload the final images. Your browser makes the web and square versions; your original file is kept exactly as it is.
product.clientRenditions: This portal lets your browser prepare the smaller versions of each image. Keep this page open until uploads are finished.
product.noImagesColour: No images for this colour yet.
product.deleteImageBody: Retailers will no longer see it. Images they already downloaded are not affected.
product.imagePublishedHint: Switch off to keep the image here without showing it.
product.territoriesHint: Country codes separated by commas, like NL, BE, DE. Leave empty for worldwide.
product.territoryInvalid: “{{code}}” is not a two-letter country code.
product.embargoHint: Retailers receive the image but may not show it before this moment.
product.expiresHint: After this moment retailers must stop using the image.
product.customLicence: Use my own licence text instead of the standard retailer licence
product.provenanceHint: Say honestly whether AI was used. This travels with the image to every shop (EU AI Act).
product.deleteHint: Deleting removes the article with all its sizes and images. To hide it temporarily, switch off Published instead.
product.deleteBody: This removes the article, its sizes and its images. Retailers' software will be told it is gone. This cannot be undone.

imports.title: Imports
imports.intro: Upload a CSV file and your images. Only what changed is updated.
imports.uploadIntro: A products.csv with one line per size, plus images named like KO-1001_NVY_1.jpg. A zip with everything works too.
imports.drop: Drop your CSV, zip or images here
imports.dropHint: Folders don't matter, file names do. Images you uploaded before are recognised and not sent again.
imports.nothing: No CSV or images found in what you chose.
imports.mode: What to do with articles missing from the file
imports.modeUpsertHint: Articles that are not in the file stay as they are.
imports.modeMirrorHint: Articles of these brands that are not in the file are unpublished. If that would be more than half, the import stops, so a broken export never empties your catalog.
imports.massOk: I really want to take more than half offline
imports.dryRunHint: See what would happen and which rows have problems.
imports.namingTitle: How should I name my images?
imports.namingIntro: Article number, colour code and position, separated by underscores:
imports.namingHint: Optionally add what the image shows (model, detail) or the angle (front, back). The same name again replaces the image.
imports.empty: Your uploads, scheduled imports and automatic uploads will be listed here.
imports.working: Working on it. This page updates by itself.
imports.dryRunDone: This was only a check. Nothing was changed.
imports.problemsHint: Rows with a problem were skipped; the rest was imported. Fix them in your file and import again.

automation.title: Automatic upload
automation.intro: Let your own systems publish for you: a file on a server, a folder, your PIM or ERP. Every change reaches your retailers without manual work.

sources.intro: Point us at a place where your export lands. We fetch it on a schedule and import what changed.
sources.empty: Add one if your PIM, ERP or DAM already exports a CSV or zip to a web address, an SFTP server or a storage bucket.

freq.manual: Only when I click Run now

sources.deleteBody: It will no longer run. Earlier imports stay in the history.
sources.formIntro: We only read. Your passwords and keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
sources.nameHint: So you recognise it, for example “Nightly PIM export”.
sources.url: Web address of the CSV or zip
sources.urlHint: Must start with https://. Addresses in a private network are refused.
sources.imagesUrlHint: Only if your images are in a different file.
sources.headerHint: For example “Authorization: Bearer …” if the address needs a login.
sources.privateKeyHint: Paste the full key, including the BEGIN and END lines.
sources.folderHint: The folder with products.csv and the images, or the path of a zip.
sources.endpointHint: Leave empty for Amazon S3. For Cloudflare R2, MinIO or Backblaze, enter their address.
sources.prefixHint: Only files under this prefix are read.
sources.pathStyleHint: Needed for MinIO and some other providers.
sources.stored: A value is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
sources.secretsNote: Use an account that can only read. Passwords and keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
sources.testAfterSave: After saving you can test the connection and see which files would be imported.

tokens.intro: An access key lets one of your own systems publish to this portal: the obx tool, a script, your PIM, n8n or Zapier. Give each system its own key, so you can switch one off without affecting the others.
tokens.newHint: The key is shown once. Store it in the system that will use it.
tokens.name: Name

scope.ingest:write: add and change articles and images

scopeHint.ingest:read: Needed to check what already exists.
scopeHint.ingest:delete: Only if the system should remove things.

tokens.expiresHint: Leave empty for no end date.
tokens.useWith: Use it together with the address {{url}}.
tokens.rotateBody: The old key stops working immediately. Put the new one in your system right away.
tokens.revokeBody: The system using this key can no longer publish. This cannot be undone.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.intro: Copy, paste, done. Pick what fits the way you work.
recipes.tokenFilled: Your new access key is already filled in below. It disappears when you leave this page.
recipes.needToken: The recipes need an access key.
recipes.docs: Every recipe can safely run again and again: unchanged articles and images cost nothing.

cli.title: obx tool
cli.body: Download the obx tool once. It uploads only changed images and waits for the result.

watch.title: Watch a folder
watch.body: Publishes automatically whenever new files land in a folder.

cron.title: Every night (cron)
cron.body: Publishes your export every night at 02:30.

windows.title: Every night (Windows)
windows.body: Run once in PowerShell as an administrator.

github.title: GitHub Actions
github.body: Publishes on every change and every night. Store the address and key as repository secrets.

curl.title: One command (curl)
curl.body: Sends a CSV and a zip of images in one request.

http.title: n8n, Make, Zapier
http.body: Use an HTTP request step. Send each article as JSON; repeating it changes nothing.

webhooks.intro: Let your own systems know when something happens, for example a retailer asking for access or an import finishing.
webhooks.empty: Add the web address of your system, n8n, Make or Zapier.
webhooks.secretHint: Your system can use it to check that a message really comes from this portal.
webhooks.deleteBody: Nothing will be sent to this address any more.

retailers.title: Retailers
retailers.intro: The shops that may use your content, their accounts and their API keys.
retailers.addIntro: Add a shop yourself, then invite its people.
retailers.search: Search by name or customer number
retailers.empty: Retailers appear here when you approve an access request or add them yourself.
retailers.referenceHint: Your customer number for this shop.
retailers.notesHint: Only visible to you and your colleagues.
retailers.blockedHint: This retailer is blocked: its accounts cannot log in and its API keys do not work.
retailers.accessHint: Changes apply immediately, also to their software.
retailers.originalsHint: Web and square versions are always available.
retailers.originalsFollow: As set for the whole portal
retailers.originalsNever: Never original files for this retailer
retailers.keysHint: For the retailer's shop system or PIM. The key gives exactly the access set above.
retailers.blockHint: Blocking stops all access at once: accounts are logged out and API keys stop working. You can undo this.
retailers.unblockHint: Unblocking restores access for its accounts and API keys.
retailers.blockBody: All accounts are logged out and all API keys stop working immediately.
retailers.unblockBody: Its accounts can log in again and its API keys work again.
retailers.deleteHint: Deletes the retailer with its accounts and API keys. Download history is kept.
retailers.deleteBody: Its accounts and API keys are removed. This cannot be undone. To stop access temporarily, block instead.

users.retailerAccountsHint: People at this shop who can log in. Each gets a personal invitation link.
users.inviteNoMail: Email is not set up on this portal. Send this link to {{email}} yourself:
users.blockBody: This person is logged out at once and can no longer log in. You can unblock the account later.
users.deleteBody: This person can no longer log in.
users.deleteAdminBody: This colleague can no longer manage the portal.

apiKeys.empty: An API key lets a shop system fetch products and images automatically.
apiKeys.name: Name of the key
apiKeys.nameHint: For example the shop system that will use it.
apiKeys.rotateBody: The current secret stops working immediately. The software using it needs the new one.
apiKeys.revokeBody: Software using this key loses access immediately. This cannot be undone.

requests.title: Access requests
requests.intro: Shops that asked for access. Approve to create their account, or decline with a short explanation.
requests.emptyHint: Retailers can ask for access via the link on your login page.
requests.linkToHint: Already a customer? Link the request to the existing retailer.
requests.inviteHint: They choose their own password via a personal link.
requests.createKeyHint: Their software collects the key by itself. Did they ask on this web page? Then you can show the key after approving.
requests.keyCreated: An API key was created. If they asked on this web page and not from their software, show the key once and pass it on safely.
requests.reasonHint: Sent to the requester. Keep it short and friendly.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: Who downloads what, through the portal and through software.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lookHint: Your logo and colour are shown to retailers on every page.
settings.removeLogoBody: The portal shows your name instead until you upload a new logo.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 5 MB. A wide logo on a transparent or white background works best.
settings.displayNameHint: Shown at the top of the portal and in emails.
settings.portalNameHint: Leave empty to use “{{example}}” in the reader's language.
settings.portalAccessHint: Applies to all retailers. Per retailer you can restrict more.
settings.accessRequestsHint: Shows a “Request access” link on the login page.
settings.originalsHint: Otherwise only web (max. 2000 px) and square versions.
settings.dataExportHint: CSV with sizes, EANs, materials and image names.
settings.selfService: Retailers may create their own API keys
settings.selfServiceHint: So their developers can connect without asking you.
settings.languagesHint: Retailers see your texts in their language when available, otherwise in English, otherwise in your main language.
settings.defaultRightsHint: For images whose data does not say otherwise.
settings.standardLicenceHint: The standard licence allows retailers to use the images to sell your products in the channels above.
settings.newContentHint: What happens with new content from imports and automatic uploads.
settings.teamHint: Colleagues who can manage this portal.
settings.systemHint: Set by whoever installed the portal.
settings.emailOffHint: Without email, you send invitation links yourself; they are shown after inviting.
settings.cronHint: Your hosting calls this address every few minutes (a cron job). Keep it to yourself.
settings.cronNever: Not called yet. Without it the portal still catches up whenever someone uses it.

account.title: My account
account.profileHint: Your name and the language of the portal and your emails.
account.languageHint: Also used for emails you receive.
account.passwordHint: Changing your password logs you out everywhere else.
account.apiKeysHint: Let your shop system or PIM fetch products and images automatically. Give your developer the key; it works for everything you can see here.

preview.banner: You are viewing the portal as your retailers see it. Your downloads here are not counted.

catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search by article number, name, colour or EAN
catalog.selectionCap: A selection holds at most {{max}} articles; the first {{max}} were added.
catalog.selectionFull: Your selection is full: it holds at most {{max}} articles. Remove some first.
catalog.downloadAllIntro: We prepare one zip with all images of these articles. You'll find it under Downloads when it is ready.
catalog.emptyFiltered: Try other filters or a different search.
catalog.empty: The brand has not published any articles yet.

variant.label: File version
variant.originalHelp: the file exactly as the brand delivered it, full size.
variant.webHelp: JPEG, at most 2000 pixels. Right for most webshops.
variant.squareHelp: the web version centred on a white square.

product.aiGeneratedHelp: This image was generated with AI. Say so where you publish it.
product.aiEditedHelp: This photo was edited with AI. Say so where you publish it.
product.noImagesHint: The article data is available already; images follow later.

selection.title: Your selection
selection.clearBody: All articles are removed from your selection.
selection.empty: Tick articles in the catalog to download them together.
selection.tooBig: More than {{max}} images: we prepare the zip in the background. You'll find it under Downloads.

ean.title: EAN list
ean.intro: Paste EANs from an order, a spreadsheet or an email. We find the matching articles and tell you which codes we don't have.
ean.label: EANs
ean.notFoundHint: Not in this brand's catalog, or not available to you.

jobs.title: Downloads
jobs.intro: Large downloads are prepared in the background and appear here when they are ready. They stay available for 7 days.
jobs.empty: Large zips you prepare from the catalog, your selection or an EAN list appear here.
jobs.started: We're preparing your zip. You can keep working; you'll find it under Downloads.

care.drip_line_dry_shade: Drip dry on a line in the shade
care.drip_dry_flat_shade: Drip dry flat in the shade

email.footer: You receive this email because of your account or request at {{portal}}.
email.linkFallback: Button not working? Copy this address into your browser: {{url}}

invite.subject: {{brand}} invites you to {{portal}}
invite.heading: You're invited
invite.body: {{brand}} has created an account for you. There you can find their final product images and article data, and download them whenever you need.
invite.expiry: This link works once and is valid until {{expires}}.
invite.ignore: Not expecting this? Then you can ignore this email.

accessRequestReceived.subject: We received your request for {{portal}}
accessRequestReceived.heading: Request received
accessRequestReceived.body: Thank you for your request to {{brand}}. We will check it and email you as soon as it has been reviewed.

accessRequestNew.subject: New access request from {{retailer}}
accessRequestNew.body: {{contact}} from {{retailer}} has asked for access to {{portal}}.

accessApproved.subject: Your access to {{portal}} is ready
accessApproved.heading: Welcome
accessApproved.apiNote: Your software can now collect its API key using the request number it received.

accessRejected.subject: About your request for {{portal}}
accessRejected.heading: Your request
accessRejected.body: Unfortunately {{brand}} cannot give you access at the moment.
accessRejected.contact: Questions? Reply to this email or contact {{brand}}.

zipReady.subject: Your download from {{portal}} is ready
zipReady.heading: Your download is ready
zipReady.body: The zip you asked for ({{files}} files) is ready.

passwordReset.subject: Choose a new password for {{portal}}
passwordReset.heading: New password
passwordReset.body: Someone asked to reset the password of your account. Choose a new one with the button below.
passwordReset.expiry: This link works once and is valid for one hour.
passwordReset.ignore: Didn't ask for this? Then you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.

fallback.errorTitle: This page could not be loaded
